Method of Attack: Ransomware operation deploying a Linux encryptor targeting VMware ESXi virtual machines
Encrypts VMware ESXi virtual machines by listing running VMs, terminating them, and encrypting VM-related files (.log, .vmdk, .vmem, .vswp, .vmsn)
Uses asymmetric encryption with ECDH on Curve25519 and symmetric encryption with ChaCha20
Appends .RTM extension to encrypted files and leaves ransom notes named '!!! Warning !!!'
